units.source_text: ——当天晚上，有为子告了我的状，她的母亲上我叔父家来了。

en.t: That very evening, Uiko told on me, and her mother came to my uncle's house.

units.source_text: 我遭到了平日非常温和的叔父的严厉叱责。

en.t: I was severely scolded by my uncle, who was usually very gentle.

units.source_text: 我诅咒有为子，甚至希望她死去。

en.t: I cursed Uiko, and even wished that she would die.

units.source_text: 数月后，这诅咒竟然应验了。

en.t: Several months later, that curse actually came true.

units.source_text: 从此以后，我确信诅咒是会应验的。

en.t: From then on, I was convinced that curses could come true.
